justification: Changes what every served DCP citation links to and prints, writes 17,489 production rows through a new script, adds a migration with triggers on regulatory_provisions, and changes the AI reader that writes every future rule page. Wrong output here sends readers to the wrong page of a planning control.

pre_impl.existing_data: regulatory_provisions pdf_page (int), page_range (int[]), pdf_printed_page (int, NULL on every served council DCP row), provision_text; dcp_chapter_registry r2_current_path and r2_public_pdf_url; the 237 chapter PDFs in R2 and the dq111_lines page-line cache.
pre_impl.assumption_mismatch: If a stored page is right but the locator cannot confirm it, the row is kept as on_page only when it holds the rule; otherwise it is left unmoved as unresolved, never guessed. If a PDF cannot be read the rows get no_source and are not moved.
pre_impl.new_vs_existing: Existing rows: dcp_page_repair.py --apply corrects them once. New rows: ai_extractor places each rule on its own page, and dcp_commit_approved runs the repair per council after every publish; migration 079 triggers void a verdict when text, page or chapter PDF changes.
pre_impl.external_source_error: An R2 download or PDF parse failure is caught per PDF in judge_pdf and returns no_source for that PDF's rows, which --check then reports; the run continues for the other PDFs.
pre_impl.frontend_type: Yes: Provision in PageGroupedProvisions and ProvisionForPDF gain optional printed_page_label and page_check (string or null); the for-property select adds both columns.
pre_impl.user_failure_mode: Council DCP rows not shown to hold the rule (unresolved, not_found, too_short, no_source, or never checked) open the chapter with no page anchor and say page not located, instead of opening a wrong page; LEP/SEPP rows are unchanged.

functions.name: locate
functions.input: rule text, Pages of one PDF, stored page, optional chunk window, anchor pages from citation_proof
functions.output: (page or None, verdict) to plan_row and _place_on_pages
functions.if_none: empty or short text returns (None, too_short); no candidate returns not_found; several returns unresolved

functions.name: printed_labels
functions.input: a dict mapping each page number to the header and footer lines printed on it
functions.output: page to printed page label, used by plan_row
functions.if_none: empty margins give an empty dict; documents labelled on under half their pages give an empty dict

functions.name: plan_row
functions.input: one served row dict from the database, the located page, its verdict and the document labels
functions.output: values to write for pdf_page, page_range, printed_page_label, page_check, page_source_path
functions.if_none: page None keeps the stored page; a label only for on_page or moved

functions.name: write
functions.input: the list of planned row values produced by plan_row for rows that changed
functions.output: an UPDATE of regulatory_provisions per 500-row batch, committed after each batch
functions.if_none: an empty list writes nothing and returns 0

functions.name: _place_on_pages
functions.input: provisions from one chunk, pypdf reader, first and last page
functions.output: sets each provision page to its located page
functions.if_none: an unlocatable rule keeps the chunk first page and is later marked unresolved by the repair

functions.name: pageAnchor and pageLabel
functions.input: pdf_page, printed_page_label and page_check fields as returned by the for-property API
functions.output: the page anchor and page text for UI and report
functions.if_none: no page gives a null anchor and null label; unchecked rows behave as before

values.if_missing: NULL on a council DCP row fails closed: no page anchor and 'page not located'; rows outside the check (no source_council) behave as before
label falls back to PDF page N
rows are planned as no_source and never moved

queries.purpose: served council DCP rules with their chapter PDF
queries.where_clause: rp.is_current AND rp.v2_is_actionable AND rp.source_council IS NOT NULL, joined to an active registry row
queries.if_zero: prints zero rules and writes nothing
queries.if_wrong: the write only lands where the registry path still equals the judged path

queries.where_clause: p.id = v.id AND p.is_current AND the active registry r2_current_path IS NOT DISTINCT FROM the judged path
queries.if_wrong: a chapter republished mid-run keeps no stale verdict (tested on local Postgres)

queries.purpose: health check: every served rule checked against its current PDF
queries.where_clause: rp.is_current AND rp.v2_is_actionable AND rp.source_council IS NOT NULL
queries.if_wrong: a stale source path counts as unchecked and fails

break_it.scenario: The same rule wording is printed on several pages (per-site controls) and the locator picks the wrong copy
break_it.what_happens: the link opens a page with the same words under a different site
break_it.how: scripts/rule_page_locator.py - several candidates give unresolved; a stored page that holds a copy stays

break_it.scenario: A bag of common words matches a page that does not hold the rule
break_it.what_happens: the link is moved to a wrong page
break_it.how: scripts/rule_page_locator.py - a move needs an ordered 8-word run on the new page

break_it.scenario: A year, date or numbered requirement in a margin counts up and is read as a page number
break_it.what_happens: the label shows a number the council never printed as a page number
break_it.how: scripts/rule_page_locator.py - furniture lines only, the token must change page to page, labels on at least half the pages

break_it.scenario: Another writer changes a rule's text or page after it was checked
break_it.what_happens: a stale on_page verdict is shown for a changed rule
break_it.how: migrations/079_rule_page_check.sql trigger clears the verdict unless page_checked_at is set in the same update
break_it.repro: local Postgres scratch DB: update provision_text, then page_check is NULL

break_it.scenario: The council publishes a new PDF for a chapter
break_it.what_happens: pages checked against the old PDF are presented as checked
break_it.how: migrations/079_rule_page_check.sql registry trigger voids page verdicts; dcp_page_repair --check fails on stale source paths
break_it.repro: local Postgres scratch DB: change r2_current_path, then page_check is NULL

break_it.scenario: The AI model returns a chunk-relative page number
break_it.what_happens: a rule is stored on page 3 of the document instead of page 15
break_it.how: scripts/ai_extractor.py:673 - the model page is ignored and the rule is located by its words

break_it.scenario: The UI shows a link for a rule whose stored page is known not to hold it
break_it.what_happens: the reader is sent to the wrong page
break_it.how: frontend-nextjs/lib/page-citation.ts - every verdict other than on_page/moved, and an unchecked council DCP row, gets no anchor and says page not located

break_it.scenario: The health check is run before the repair or after a failed post-publish repair
break_it.what_happens: served rules have no page verdict, so their links may open the chunk start page
break_it.how: scripts/dcp_page_repair.py:194 - check() counts rows whose page_source_path differs from the current registry path, including NULL, and exits 1

break_it.scenario: The chunk-start page holds the same common words as the rule in a different order
break_it.what_happens: the wrong page would be marked on_page and linked as checked
break_it.how: scripts/rule_page_locator.py locate - the stored page and every candidate must print the rule in order (8-word run or citation_proof anchors); found by cross-review 2026-09-26

break_it.scenario: A document's numbering restarts per section and the first page of a section has an unreadable footer
break_it.what_happens: that page would be labelled with the previous section's count (2.5-19 instead of 2.6-1)
break_it.how: scripts/rule_page_locator.py page_numbering - numbers are filled only between readable pages of one run; leave-one-out over 3,589 readable pages: 1 wrong

break_it.scenario: One printed rule is split into several partial matches because the stored text orders its parts differently from the page, or is a whole multi-page section
break_it.what_happens: a correct stored page is reported unresolved and the link is removed
break_it.how: scripts/rule_page_locator.py occurrences - a place is scored over a rule-length stretch; overlapping stretches are one place

falsifiable_check.fails_when: --check exits 1 while any served rule has no page verdict for its current PDF (it does today: DQ-113 open); the pytest files fail when the phrase gate, the window filter, the neighbour count or the chunk-start fallback is removed (14 mutants tried, all killed).
falsifiable_check.observed_red: 2026-09-26: `python scripts/dcp_page_repair.py --check` against production exited 1 (page_check column missing -- no served rule has a verdict). Reverting ai_extractor._place_on_pages to the chunk start page: tests/test_ai_reader_rule_page.py 2 failed. Locator mutations (phrase gate removed, window filter removed, neighbour count loosened, len(ok)==1 loosened, stored-page hold check removed, anchor/word agreement removed): each made tests/test_rule_page_locator.py fail.

post_merge.manual_verify: Yes: apply migrations/079_rule_page_check.sql BEFORE merging (the for-property select reads the new columns), then python scripts/dcp_page_repair.py --apply, then --check must exit 0 and DQ-113 is flipped to fixed.
